claims.text: This repository contains a service with one deployable service and 23 routes, consumers, or scheduled jobs.
The codebase is written primarily in TypeScript with 96 source files and Python with 28 source files.
It uses Docker and docker-compose for deployment, with a backend Dockerfile and compose.yml configuration.
The project includes GitHub Actions workflows for testing, deployment, and release automation.
The backend service runs FastAPI with four workers and is built from the repository Dockerfile.
PostgreSQL runs as the db service using the postgres:18 image and is accessed via psycopg.
Sentry is used as an outside service with the sentry-sdk dependency.
Adminer runs as a Compose service using the adminer image.
Mailpit runs as a Compose service using the axllent/mailpit image.
Playwright runs as a Compose service built from the repository and is used for tests.
A proxy runs as a Compose service using the traefik:v3.7 image.
There are five Alembic database migrations in backend/app/alembic/versions.
A typical request passes through backend/app/api/routes then backend/app then backend/app/core.
19 of 23 traced routes reach the database.
POST /api/v1/users/ is handled by create_user in backend/app/api/routes/users.py.
create_user calls get_user_by_email in backend/app/crud.py, create_user in backend/app/crud.py, generate_new_account_email in backend/app/utils.py and send_email.
create_user in backend/app/crud.py calls get_password_hash in backend/app/core/security.py.
get_user_by_email reaches the database via session.exec in backend/app/crud.py.
POST /api/v1/login/access-token is handled by login_access_token in backend/app/api/routes/login.py.
login_access_token calls authenticate in backend/app/crud.py and create_access_token in backend/app/core/security.py.
authenticate calls get_user_by_email and verify_password.
authenticate reaches the database via session.add in backend/app/crud.py.
The backend exposes 23 HTTP routes across five route modules: items, login, private, users, and utils.
Three Typer CLI commands are defined in scripts/prepare_release.py: prepare, current-version, and release-notes.
Three Python scripts serve as program entry points: backend/app/initial_data.py, scripts/add_latest_release_date.py, and scripts/prepare_release.py.
Seven package scripts are defined across frontend/package.json, packages/react-email/package.json, and the root package.json for development, building, and testing.

The repository contains 96 TypeScript source files totaling 10,010 lines, 28 Python source files totaling 1,736 lines, 1 CSS file with 124 lines, 8 shell files with 76 lines, and 3 HTML files with 16 lines.
Frontend components in Admin, Items, UserSettings, and Common all depend on the ui component library with 20, 18, 10, and 8 references respectively.
The frontend ui component library depends on frontend/src/lib with 23 references.
Frontend routes depend on the ui component library with 15 references, on the Common component with 7 references, and on hooks with 7 references.
Frontend src and frontend/src/routes have a bidirectional dependency with 6 references from src to routes.
The frontend client/client module depends on client/core with 14 references.
In the react-email package, emails depend on ui with 12 references.
Backend app/api/routes depends on backend/app with 10 references.
Backend app depends on backend/app/core with 5 references, and these two have a bidirectional dependency.
Backend app/api and backend/app/api/routes have a bidirectional dependency, each with 5 references to the other.
Backend app and backend/app/api have a bidirectional dependency.

The most depended-upon files are frontend/src/lib/utils.ts used by 27 files, frontend/src/client/index.ts used by 20 files, frontend/src/components/ui/button.tsx used by 18 files, backend/app/core/config.py used by 16 files, and backend/app/models.py used by 16 files.
Run the frontend development server with bun run dev in the frontend directory.
Build the frontend with bun run build in the frontend directory.
Run frontend tests with bun run test in the frontend directory.
Run the frontend development server from the repository root with bun run dev.
Run frontend tests from the repository root with bun run test.
Build react-email templates with bun run build in the packages/react-email directory.
Run react-email development server on port 3333 with bun run dev in the packages/react-email directory.
CI updates pre-commit hooks with uv run prek update --freeze --cooldown-days 7.
CI extracts release version with uv run python scripts/prepare_release.py current-version.
CI generates release notes with uv run python scripts/prepare_release.py release-notes.
Recently closed pull requests were merged a median of 43 hours after being opened.
